content:
Non spicy alternates to common instant noodles like maggie/yippee etc?
Tired of the same flavours ( maggie, waiwai, top ramen, yippee, chings, different cup noodles ), want something new. Tried this thing Nissin Korean noodles and I could hardly take 2 bites, it was so spicy. 
 

Any recommendations? Need it for college snacks so nothing too expensive. 


Or if not, any recipes that you swear by and that don't require much ingredients? The vegetable market is super far.
